Namespace: demo

APIS
  Available    virtualmachines.kubevirt.io                        required VM lookup
  Available    virtualmachineinstances.kubevirt.io                required running instance, interfaces and node
  Available    network-attachment-definitions.k8s.cni.cncf.io     optional Multus secondary network configuration
  Unavailable  networkpolicies.networking.k8s.io                  optional NetworkPolicies that may select the launcher pod
  Unavailable  userdefinednetworks.k8s.ovn.org                    optional OVN-Kubernetes user-defined networks (presence indicates OVN-Kubernetes)
  Unavailable  subnets.kubeovn.io                                 optional Kube-OVN subnets (presence indicates Kube-OVN)
  Unavailable  nodenetworkstates.nmstate.io                       optional kubernetes-nmstate node state (presence indicates nmstate)

ACCESS
  Allowed      get   virtualmachines.kubevirt.io
  Allowed      get   virtualmachineinstances.kubevirt.io
  Allowed      list  pods
  Allowed      get   network-attachment-definitions.k8s.cni.cncf.io
  Allowed      list  networkpolicies.networking.k8s.io

FEATURES
  Available    inspect / topology / diagnose: VM, VMI and virt-launcher pod reads are allowed
  Available    trace plan: needs the VMI and its virt-launcher pod
  Available    Multus NAD analysis
  Unknown      host collect / host trace: node-side; run 'kubectl-netdoctor host capabilities' on the node
